name: updateEHR
shortDescription: Allows a doctor to securely update a patient's Electronic Health Record, ensuring data integrity and compliance.
description:
Overview

Enables doctors to update a patient's Electronic Health Record (EHR) by adding notes, diagnoses, or treatment plans, and may trigger external synchronization.

Intended use

Called by the doctor-facing UI when a doctor submits changes to a patient's EHR. The UI provides parameters such as medicalRecordId, content, recordType, diagnosisCode, and treatmentPlan.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the MedicalRecord entity using params.medicalRecordId.
  2. Verify that the authenticated doctor is authorized to update this record (e.g., by checking doctorId in the record or assignment to the Patient).
  3. Update the MedicalRecord's content, recordType, diagnosisCode, and treatmentPlan using ctx.data.update.
  4. Audit-log the EHR update using ctx.audit.log, capturing the changes made and the doctor responsible.
  5. Optionally, trigger external synchronization with the EHRSystem if configured.
  6. Return the updated MedicalRecord.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • Patient
  • Doctor

External Services

  • EHRSystem
